claims: Netflix launched with an exclusive New York Yankees vs. San Francisco Giants game on March 25, 2026.
Netflix has a three-year 2026-2028 partnership to stream select marquee MLB games.
The partnership includes Opening Night and the Home Run Derby.
The 2026 MLB season opened on March 25 with the New York Yankees vs. San Francisco Giants at Oracle Park.
Netflix has secured rights to three major MLB events per year.
The three MLB events are Opening Night, the T-Mobile Home Run Derby, and a special Field of Dreams game.
The Field of Dreams game is Twins vs. Phillies in August.
Barry Bonds is a guest analyst for Netflix MLB coverage.
Albert Pujols is on the Netflix MLB broadcasting team.
Elle Duncan is the host for Netflix MLB coverage.
Netflix MLB games are exclusive to Netflix.
Netflix MLB games will not be available on local regional sports networks (RSNs) in those markets.
All MLB games on Netflix are included in existing subscriptions.
Netflix MLB games are available on any device that supports the Netflix app.
2026 schedule includes Yankees vs. Giants on March 25 as Opening Night.
2026 schedule includes T-Mobile Home Run Derby on July 13.
2026 schedule includes MLB at Field of Dreams as Twins vs. Phillies in August.
